reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 12.3 expressly states Customer has made no no-hire commitment and preserves Customer's right to hire anyone responding to general recruitment, matching the preferred position of no non-solicit on Customer.
§ 30.1 is a standard independent-contractor clause that imposes no personnel restriction on Customer, so nothing in the cited paragraphs creates a restrictive covenant.
No redline or counterparty comment is expected for a compliant finding, and the rendered text is unchanged — appropriate here.

The failing deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are inapplicable because no non-solicit obligation exists to measure; they are not evidence of a defect in this finding.
